Week 10 · Hour 1 · explanation · 2 min

A median baseline matches absolute loss

The training-target median is a constant predictor.

It minimizes training absolute error.

Defined teaching contract / analytic illustration.
2 minutes / explanation. Teaching intent: A median baseline matches absolute loss. Explain the one-dimensional absolute-loss objective: moving c changes how many observations lie to its left and right, with a median balancing them. For even n, any point between middle order statistics is a minimizer. This does not guarantee best held-out performance. Visual purpose: The training-target median is a constant predictor. It minimizes training absolute error.
